scenes.zh: 每一手，练习更好的判断。
scenes.voiceEn: Your next decision starts here. Practice Hold'em offline.
scenes.voiceZh: 每一手，练习更好的判断。离线德州扑克，随时开练。

scenes.voiceEn: Learn at the table, one guided hand at a time.
scenes.voiceZh: 跟着互动引导，在一手手实战中，学会规则。

scenes.voiceEn: Review the reasoning behind each decision.
scenes.voiceZh: 回看关键决策，理解每次行动背后的理由。

scenes.zh: 同一副牌，再试一种选择。
scenes.voiceEn: Replay the same deal. Explore another choice.
scenes.voiceZh: 重打同一副牌，探索另一种选择。

scenes.voiceEn: Explore the odds. Virtual chips. No account needed.
scenes.voiceZh: 看清胜率，让练习继续。虚拟筹码，无需登录。
